name: Sidhant Anand
bio: Sidhant is a British-Indian actor who made his professional stage debut as Bruce Bogtrotter in the RSC's Matilda the Musical in London's West End, performing in nearly 50 shows between 2023-24. He went on to film a Sky TV series on Mozart in Hungary. His feature film debut came in early 2025 with Fing!, an adaptation of the hugely popular children's novel by David Walliams, in which he plays the role of Tyler. He is also attached to upcoming projects in film, television, and audio slated for 2025-26. Passionate about Greek mythology, drama, and adventure, Sidhant also enjoys gaming with his elder brother and taking his two golden retrievers on long walks exploring the English countryside.

credits.title: FING!
credits.overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.
